channel.title: The Grant Desk - Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Playful Obscura 2027: Arthouse Games Residency Africa (Addis Ababa, Goethe-Institut and A MAZE.)
item.description: Goethe-Institut Addis Abeba, with Creative HUB Ethiopia, A MAZE., British Council and Alliance Ethio-Francaise · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Three-week funded residency hosting two artists at a time. 2027 financial terms were not published in the call excerpt we could verify; the 2026 Accra edition provided accommodation, a production budget of up to EUR 1,000 and a EUR 300 stipend. No application fee.

item.title: GAIN SSA: AI Safety Essentials Fellowship (inaugural cohort)
item.description: GAIN SSA (Global AI Youth Network, Sub-Saharan Africa) · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Micro-grant pool funding top capstone proposals at USD 500 to 1,000 each (capped at USD 1,000), usable for compute access, communication work such as Substack Pro subscriptions for writers, or travel to AI alignment conferences in Sub-Saharan Africa. The fellowship itself is free to attend (no participation fee, no application fee); no stipend is paid during the program.

item.title: Delfina Foundation x Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation: Open Call for Artists from Portugal and Portuguese-Speaking African Nations (London residency)
item.description: Delfina Foundation, in partnership with the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation (UK Branch) · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Twelve-week fully funded residency: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials budget of GBP 1,200, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. No application fee.

item.title: Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Think Tanger 2027 (Tangier, Morocco)
item.description: Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Think Tanger, Morocco · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,500 subsidy for a two-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL. No application fee.

item.title: Pulitzer Center: Global South Civil Society Microgrants 2026
item.description: Pulitzer Center · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 to USD 4,000 per project. Applicants name the amount requested and submit a draft budget. Funds are transferred to the partner after the agreement is signed; partners file a financial narrative and outcomes report at the end but are NOT required to collect detailed receipts. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Delfina Foundation: Open Call for Curators Based in Central and West Africa (London residency)
    https://www.delfinafoundation.com/open-calls/current/open-call-for-curators-based-in-central-and-west-africa/
    Delfina Foundation · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Fully supported: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials and research allowance of GBP 70 per week, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. Supported by Delfina Foundation's Network of Patrons for Africa. No application fee.
  • University of Johannesburg Artists in Residence 2027
    https://arts.uj.ac.za/artists-in-residence/
    UJ Arts & Culture, University of Johannesburg · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of ZAR 12,000 per month across a 10-month residency, so roughly ZAR 120,000 in total. No travel or accommodation budget on top of the stipend, and studio or rehearsal space is limited rather than guaranteed. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Marrakech IFF: Atlas Workshops 2026 (Films in Shooting or Post-Production)
    https://atlasateliers.marrakech-festival.com/en/call-for-applications
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite programme is covered. Cash prizes are awarded by a dedicated jury at the close of the Workshops; the festival does not publish the prize amounts on the call page.
  • Marrakech IFF: Atlas Station 2026 (Producers Track)
    https://atlasateliers.marrakech-festival.com/en/call-for-applications
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite professional programme is covered.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Heart2World Publishing: Heart2World Book Prize 2026 (Inaugural, Poetry)
    https://heart2worldpublishing.org/prize/
    Heart2World Publishing · deadline 05 Aug 2026 · NGN 250,000 cash prize, a full publishing and marketing package (valued at approximately NGN 5 million), and 100 percent net royalties on the published collection. No entry or reading fee.
